title: Aeromagnetic survey of the U.S. Atlantic continental margin area 32-76, 34-76
citation: Behrendt, J.C., and Klitgord, K.D., 1980, Aeromagnetic survey of the U.S. Atlantic continental margin area 32-76, 34-76: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-80-284, map scale 1:250,000.
notes: Offshore aeromagnetic total-intensity contour sheet, areas 32-76 and 34-76 (Atlantic continental margin east of the Carolinas, about 76-78°W, well east of the South Carolina coast); page 2 is a second copy of the same sheet. No land, geology, wells or South Carolina features; title block and survey specifications only (OCR text garbled; checked on page images). Magnetic contours do not fit the contour fields (structure or isopach), so nothing was recorded. SUBSURFACE: none.
